desc:
🎃 HAUNTED MANSION EVENT & FREE SWORD SKIN OUT NOW

🥊 NOOB INVASION [BETA]

Noobs are invading Robloxia... and only YOU can save it! 💥

"Noob Invasion" is an action-packed co-op wave survival roguelike brawler. Fight off relentless waves of Noobs, unlock powerful new abilities, master unique fighting styles, and defeat the Noob King! 👑

🎮 CONTROLS:
• M1 - Hit Combo
• E - Special Ability
• S - Super
• Q - Dash

🔥 GAME FEATURES:
• ⚔️ Co-op Wave Survival - Fight solo or team up in parties of 2-4 players!
• 🥋 Fighting Styles & Abilities - Unlock and customize your playstyle.
• 👑 Epic Boss Battles - Test your skills against the Noob King.
• 🎲 Roguelike Progression - Power up and adapt every run.
• 📱 Cross-Platform Support - Play on PC, Mobile, and Console!

👍 LIKE & FAVORITE the game to support future updates!

💬 Join our community group to stay updated:
